profile.summary: Willing and eager to learn.  Enjoy wearing many hats.  My objectives are to continue to learn and grow.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work with applications written in different development languages such as Java, Vb6, C#.net, VB.net. 
Applications are both client and server side.   
Participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, including specification gathering, design, coding, testing, documentation, and maintenance.
Create and modify design patterns as needed.
Use Version One to manage projects and daily work.
Give demonstrations to subject matter experts.
Work in both windows and Unix environments. 
Conduct software design and code reviews.
Troubleshoot and solve technical problems.
Work with VMware to test and upgrade software in Windows 7 thru 10.
Assist user support, DBAs and other departments with software issues, whether related to the main application or the supporting third party applications that the main application depends on such as form creation, licensing or image manipulation. Contact third party vendors as part of support, as needed.

company.name: Frontier Science & Technology Research Foundation, Inc. (FSTRF)

positions.title: Oracle/PL SQL Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Create and modify forms and menus using Oracle Designer and Oracle forms
•	Create reports using Oracle Reports Developer
•	Alter Oracle 8,9 and 10G database tables on an as need basis for fields, constraints and indexes and views
•	Alter the ERD on an as need basis for new fields and tables
•	Write and maintain PL/SQL packages, procedures and functions
•	Utilize SQL designer and Toad for database data verification and building SQL statements to join tables
•	Enhance and make corrections to the Oracle system as part of the migration process from Cobol to Oracle
•	Perform trace and explain plans to ensure SQL statements are optimized.
•	Communicate with QA and support staff regarding specs and design.
•	Provide estimates for enhancements.
•	Daily use of version control software from Synergy to Team Foundation Server.
•	Testing

positions.title: Client Services Conversion Specialist
positions.description:
•	Created reports and forms using Oracle Reports that contained an Oracle front end form
•	Wrote triggers that performed actions to adhere to custom rules based on client  needs
•	Wrote packages that performed common, repetitive procedure and functions 
•	Wrote scripts in SQL to modify client data per client needs 
•	Wrote conversion programs in PL/SQL to convert client data from one format to another 
•	Wrote scripts to read in data from files to be applied to the clients’ oracle database
•	Communicate with clients

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for the outsourced File Tracking Program in Delphi IDE 
•	Created an import/export link to move data to/from the Mas90 Accounting Software 
•	Created an Archive system 
•	Created reports using Crystal Reports based on specific needs of the user and the departments
•	Converted the outsourced database to Paradox 
•	Responsible for database management
•	Worked with users to enhance the software to conform to their specific department needs by analyzing what they need and how best to enhance and utilize, perform the work and then train them on those functions

positions.title: Delphi Developer
positions.description: Assisted in the development of the Microfund Accounting Program using the Delphi IDE.  Database was in Paradox and the report writer was Crystal Reports.

volunteerExperiences.description: Enhancements and maintenance of Lockport Cruise website using Adobe GoLive.

I volunteer for whatever area is needed for the event that is going on.  Positions have been with interacting with the public that are attending the event.  I've collected donations, sales of theatre props and concessions and more.
